cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted the chores fairly. I wash this pan; you owe me two shopping trips.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two trips for one pan? That's not fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dried cheese is a premium job. But I want us both happy with the arrangement. What would you offer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll soak it first. Then it just needs a wipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A prepared-pan rate, naturally. One shopping trip, and you supply the detergent. You choose the day; I'll mark us settled when the shopping's home.
